title: Zero-shot Entity and Tweet Characterization with Designed Conditional Prompts and Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning language models on text corpora from seven different news media houses and analyzing the sentiment and descriptive adjectives of zero-shot generated entailments to compare stances and characterizations of specific entities across different sources.

Evaluating the sentiment of model-generated characterizations of specific political figures, explicitly comparing the positivity/negativity of outputs for members of the ruling party versus the opposition party using models fine-tuned on news and social media datasets.

Prompting fine-tuned language models with yes/no questions, multiple-choice options, and reading comprehension formats to classify whether tweets contain specific abstract biased perspectives, such as propaganda, disinformation, dogmatism, and emotionally manipulative language.
